# Vendored dependency

Three.js 0.180.0 (MIT), retrieved from the official npm registry:
https://registry.npmjs.org/three/-/three-0.180.0.tgz

Included unchanged files: `build/three.module.js`, `build/three.core.js`, `examples/jsm/loaders/GLTFLoader.js`, `examples/jsm/controls/OrbitControls.js`, `examples/jsm/utils/BufferGeometryUtils.js`, and `LICENSE`.

All browser dependencies are served locally. No CDN, telemetry, remote font, deployment, or package installation is required to view this deliverable.

Official documentation:
- https://threejs.org/docs/#examples/en/loaders/GLTFLoader
- https://threejs.org/docs/#examples/en/controls/OrbitControls

This pinned version was selected for this preview; it is not a claim to be the latest version.
